identity.title: Move RecipeCommandSurface UI dispatcher scheduling to Shell composition

origin.kind: explicit user request to continue RecipeCommandSurface refactoring
origin.summary: The user asked for RecipeCommandSurface refactoring to continue until the remaining proven responsibility boundaries are complete. A post-PL-0024 source audit found direct Dispatcher.Yield and Application.Current.Dispatcher calls inside the command surface.

state.current_summary: PL-0025 resolved: direct WPF dispatcher scheduling was moved from RecipeCommandSurface to existing OpenVisionShellHostView callbacks, focused scheduler and regression contracts passed, Debug builds passed with zero warnings/errors, and the final owner/navigation audit is recorded.

objective.summary: Move UI dispatcher yielding and render flushing out of RecipeCommandSurface into existing OpenVisionShellHostView composition callbacks while preserving recipe selection/creation behavior, status transitions, command names, and shutdown ownership.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; keep C:\Git\2D\Original read-only.
Do not reopen or repeat PL-0022, PL-0023, or PL-0024.
Keep RecipeCommandSurface responsible for recipe state, command state, and status projection; OpenVisionShellHostView owns the WPF Dispatcher implementation.
Do not add an interface, manager, factory, provider, event bus, wrapper, or manual partial.
Add callbacks only at the end of the constructor parameter list so existing callers remain source-compatible.
Preserve the existing DispatcherPriority.Background yield and DispatcherPriority.Render flush semantics.
Do not include locator overlay image loading in this issue; audit it separately only if an independent owner is proven.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or modify Original from this refactoring slice.

criteria.text: The current and intended dispatcher owner, caller, dependency direction, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, XAML contract, and shortest reading route are documented from source.

RecipeCommandSurface contains no direct WPF Dispatcher or Application.Current dispatcher calls; OpenVisionShellHostView supplies the concrete callbacks while recipe state and status remain owned by the Surface.
Focused injected scheduler contracts prove that recipe selection and recipe creation invoke the scheduler callbacks and preserve the existing switch status path, and the required Debug builds pass.

Handoff and codebase navigation record the new scheduler boundary, preserved public/XAML contracts, first-contributor reading route, changed files, and the remaining Surface debt; runtime UI limits are explicit.

milestones.summary: Audit dispatcher calls and prove the smallest Shell-owned scheduling boundary.
Route recipe selection and creation scheduling through existing Shell callbacks without adding an abstraction layer.
Run focused injected scheduler contracts and Debug builds.
Complete owner, MVVM, command/binding, partial/folder, navigation, and first-contributor audit.

artifacts.summary: Focused evidence for the RecipeCommandSurface WPF Dispatcher boundary.

evidence.observation: The source audit records two Dispatcher.Yield calls and one Application.Current.Dispatcher Render flush inside RecipeCommandSurface. The owner map records the before/after call path, mutable-state writer, Shell composition/lifetime owner, preserved XAML contract, and the reason this is an independent external WPF scheduling boundary. Locator image loading and recipe/file policy are explicitly excluded as separate concerns.

RecipeCommandSurface now calls yieldToUi and flushUi callbacks at the two former scheduling points. OpenVisionShellHostView supplies the concrete WPF Dispatcher implementation. A direct WPF Dispatcher/Application.Current search in the Surface is clear; the only remaining scheduler names are callback fields and their call sites. No new abstraction or partial was introduced.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke x64 Debug and OpenVisionLab.sln Debug builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Copied-runtime Dispatcher boundary passed 2/2; Clipboard regression passed 3/3; RefreshOptions passed 1/1; Validation Set success projection passed 1/1; Validation Set error projection passed 1/1. A direct Dispatcher/Application.Current search in RecipeCommandSurface returned no matches. Actual desktop WPF, device, and long-run limits remain unverified.

The final audit records Surface/Shell owners, callback dependency direction, mutable-state and lifetime owners, preserved XAML command/property contracts, the shortest reading route, no partial/folder addition, and the explicit overlay/file-policy boundary. Documentation index, RefactorAudit, readiness, issue-ledger validation, and git diff checks passed; the final Debug builds and copied-runtime contracts are recorded in m3-focused. Actual WPF visual and long-running runtime matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: Move only UI dispatcher scheduling to two optional callbacks supplied by the existing OpenVisionShellHostView composition owner. Keep recipe state, command state, status projection, XAML names, and image/file policy in their current owners.

Use two optional concrete callbacks appended to the existing constructor instead of a scheduler interface or wrapper. Preserve Background yield, Render flush, constructor compatibility, and Shell lifetime ownership.

Keep the callback-only scheduler boundary after the copied-runtime contract proved selection and creation callback invocation and the existing Clipboard, RefreshOptions, and Validation Set projection regressions remained green. No desktop WPF matrix is claimed.

Close the Dispatcher boundary: the existing Shell owns concrete WPF scheduling, the Surface retains protected recipe and XAML state, no manual partial or new folder is justified, and the remaining overlay/file policy requires a new independent proof before reopening.

PL-0025 resolved after all four milestones and criteria were evidenced. No further RecipeCommandSurface split is justified by this source audit; reopen only for a new independent boundary, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency contract.
